text:
Maria H: Quick check — posted a first draft of the blog pilot + demo flow in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/blog-pilot-draft. Need approvals by EOD Thu so we can lock CTAs and webinar seats. Ping @Samir for benchmark numbers, @Jessie for headline/messaging, @Ana for inbound routing + webinar ops. TL;DR: 800-1200 words, includes 3 benchmark callouts, one customer quote placeholder. Can we confirm the demo cadence (3-min overview + 15-min Q&A)?
Samir D: Gave numbers in doc — top-line perf: 45% cost reduction on steady-state, p50 latency 120ms, p95 420ms. I'll add a short blurb under 'Benchmarks'. Do we want to call out config (dedicated vs hosted)?
Jessie K: Read it, love the narrative arc. Suggest simplifying headline to 'Predictable LLM inference at production scale' and tighten the hero CTA. Also need legal quickpass on the customer quote placeholder. :eyes:
Ana G: For webinar routing — recommend flow A (registration -> confirmation email w/ demo time -> calendar invite -> gated follow-up). We should map HubSpot list to 'product-launch' list. I'll drop the segments in the doc.
Leo T: Demo cadence OK. Requesting 1 slide showing fallback policies + cost controls. I'll prep that slide and drop png into the asset folder.
Samir D: re: dedicated vs hosted — suggest generic phrasing 'flexible deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private)' to avoid a pricing callout. I'll add a one-liner.
Jessie K: CTA matrix draft:
```
Primary CTA: Request a demo -> demo form -> SDR flow
Secondary CTA: Try hosted API -> free credits -> signup flow
Tertiary: Read benchmark -> longform benchmark download
```
Can we make primary CTA above the fold and add a 'compare options' link?
Maria H: yes to CTA placement. @PublishingBot can you create the shortlink for the benchmark PDF once Leo uploads?
PublishingBot: uploaded assets watcher — noted, will generate shortlink when file appears at /assets/bench/pilot-bench.png and /assets/bench/pilot-report.pdf :white_check_mark:
Ana G: For inbound routing, propose these rules: high-intent demo form -> SDR queue, trial signups -> product-qualified leads tag, benchmark downloads -> nurture drip (3 emails). I'll paste the HubSpot list IDs in the doc.
Jessie K: legal: please route quote placeholder to legal@redwood.ai for quickpass. Also double-check phrasing on 'cost reduction' claim.
Samir D: I'll add a short methodology note under Benchmarks to back the % figure.
Maria H: timeline check — we need final content locked by Thu 5pm PT. If any blockers, call a 10-min sync tomorrow 3pm PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Leo T: acked, dropping slide by EOD today.
Jessie K: I can do a final copy pass Wed morning.
Ana G: I'll set up HubSpot segments and draft the confirmation email templates by Wed afternoon.
Maria H: perfect — ping here when you drop assets so @PublishingBot can make links. End.
